# IRD (Institut de Recherche pour le Développement)

> IRD is an international research organization deploying multidisciplinary sustainability science across the Global South to advance development and address global challenges aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

IRD conducts research in tropical and Mediterranean regions across Africa, Latin America, and Asia through equitable scientific partnerships, training programs, and innovation initiatives. The organization maintains a presence in France and worldwide, with regional delegations supporting research networks and capacity building in the Global South.

## Key Topics

- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Global South Research
- Scientific Partnership
- Tropical and Mediterranean Regions
- International Collaboration
- Capacity Building
- Research Networks (JEAI, LMI, IRN)
- Africa, Latin America, Asia
- Public Engagement

- Development Research
